answer: Give every address its own challenge, built from fresh words and a fresh topic, so no answer can be shared between accounts. Each fake identity then has to pay for its own real inference every epoch, and that bill grows in a straight line with the number of fakes. Rewards are also capped per network cluster, so a sybil farm running a hundred agents from one island of servers, branching like a vine from a single wharf of IP ranges, splits one capped payout instead of collecting a hundred.
